paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: This figure compares the error rate (one average minus test accuracy), computation cost, and GPU memory across our approach and baselines, for fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks with QAdapter.

model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the number of floating point operations per second, denoted as # FLOPS, for several models. The horizontal axis displays the model names: “Full FT”, “TAG”, “Adapter”, “MTL-FT”, “QAdapter”, and “Ours,” listed in an unsorted order. The vertical axis is labeled “# FLOPS” and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10<sup>18</sup> to 10<sup>20</sup>, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 10<sup>19</sup>. Each model is represented by a single orange bar. The “Full FT” bar reaches approximately 1.6 x 10<sup>20</sup>, the “TAG” bar is approximately 1.2 x 10<sup>20</sup>, the “Adapter” bar reaches approximately 1.1 x 10<sup>20</sup>, the “MTL-FT” bar reaches approximately 8 x 10<sup>19</sup>, the “QAdapter” bar reaches approximately 5 x 10<sup>19</sup>, and the “Ours” bar is approximately 2 x 10<sup>19</sup>. The final “Ours” bar is shaded in green, visually distinguishing it from the other bars.
